verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is a robotics framework with a launch system for coordinating nodes, so asking whether it can version, review, and roll back user-built automations is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no first-party versioning, review, or rollback for launch configurations, nodes, or other automations. Rosbag record and play captures message data, not automation definitions, and versioning ROS code in an external VCS is a user-side workaround that earns no credit.
